INSERT INTO order_items (shop_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.shopId}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.image}, #{item.salesPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subTotal}, #{item.insuranceDetail}, #{item.insuranceFee}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, is_deleted, created_at FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT oi.product_id, MAX(oi.product_name) AS product_name, MAX(oi.image) AS image, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.shop_id = #{shopId} AND oi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.order_status NOT IN (1, 6) AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_at >= #{start} AND o.pay_at < #{end} GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY sales_quantity DESC, oi.product_id LIMIT #{limit}
